payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning': the couple is drawn to New Zealand and needs the licence, celebrant, recognition and outdoor-ceremony steps before committing to a region or lodge, so the invitations to Wedded Concierge appear only once those are covered and the post turns to regions, venues and planning. The Wedded Advisor is positioned for planning only, never for the licence or legal paperwork. Each subtext carries one brand-facts reassurance: fee in writing (primary), single point of contact (secondary), AUD quotes, time zone and inclusions in writing (closing). No figures, 'free', perks, Privileges or availability wording. All four tracked links already appear once each with correct UTMs, so no copy change is made. A printable New Zealand licence-steps checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
